thread:
maya: Quick thread — need alignment on private deploy sequencing. Two big asks stacked: VPC control plane for FinSecure and fully air-gapped on-prem for AcmeHealth. Do we do control-plane-first (VPC) then airgap packaging later, or build an airgap-capable package + control plane in parallel? Criteria: security signoff, install surface, rollout risk, sales timelines. Thoughts? @kiran @andrew @sarah

kiran: my 2¢ — control-plane-first (VPC) is lower infra risk: most pieces reuse hosted control-plane work, auth/metrics/billing glue already exists. Airgap packaging touches installers, offline upgrades, KMS/HSM patterns. Parallel would double scope.

andrew: also consider model artifact strategy — airgap customers expect bundled model tarballs and offline patch flow. That affects model size, update cadence, and runtime compatibility (quantized vs full). If we do control-plane-first we need a clear migration story for models.

sarah: from sales: FinSecure wants control-plane + VPC ASAP (they care about network isolation, not full airgap). AcmeHealth is explicit about no egress for training logs + audit — airgap is must. Both are high ARR but different timelines: FinSecure is Q3 proof-of-concept, AcmeHealth is Q4 pilot.

oliver: packaging notes — airgap requires: 1) offline installer (apt/rpm + tarball option), 2) local KMS/HSM integration, 3) upgrade path without internet, 4) signing/verification of artifacts. Rough estimate: baseline airgap MVP = ~8 dev-weeks + 4 QA-weeks + doc. Control-plane VPC work = ~4 dev-weeks + 2 QA-weeks.

maya: OK useful. Proposed options: A) Control-plane-first (fast path to FinSecure), B) Airgap-first (satisfy AcmeHealth but delays VPC customers), C) Split MVP: minimal airgap installer for select customers + VPC control plane for others in parallel. Need launch criteria for each.

kiran: launch criteria suggestion for Control-plane-first: - V1 control plane deployed to customer VPC with auth and telemetry disabled by default - E2E deploy test in customer's subnet - SLOs: 99.5% control-plane availability for scheduled windows - documented rollback + playbook.

andrew: launch criteria for Airgap MVP: - signed model bundle mechanism + local model loader - offline installer that passes installation & upgrade smoke tests - KMS/HSM integration guide + local key rotation example - automated smoke local inference test (zero egress)

sarah: customer acceptance criteria (sales): - trial customer can install with SRE support in <=3 days - security review signoff from customer infosec - access to runbook and escalation path - pricing/packaging clear for private tier

maya: tradeoffs: Control-plane-first quicker revenue for some customers, less initial engineering burden. Airgap-first unlocks most regulated deals but pushes timeline and increases QA. Split MVP reduces risk but requires careful staffing.

kiran: staffing / resourcing: if we prioritize Control-plane-first we can greenlight for Q3 PoC with 2 engs + 1 eng-qa. Airgap MVP needs dedicated 2 engs + 1 sec eng for review. Not enough overlap to do both without prolonged timelines.

oliver: operational caveat — airgap customers will need us to support offline upgrades for at least 12 months; that increases long-term support cost. Recommend a support surcharge for airgapped installs.

maya: propose decision framework: score options against Revenue (near-term), Engineering effort, Customer risk, Security/compliance, and Strategic value. Quick vote?

andrew: vote: Control-plane-first (A) — high near-term unblock.

sarah: vote: Split MVP (C) — keeps FinSecure happy and signal to AcmeHealth.

kiran: vote: Control-plane-first (A) with a committed runway to build airgap tooling in Q4.

maya: leaning A then C. Action items: 1) @kiran — draft control-plane VPC runbook + minimal SLOs by EOD Fri (ticket). 2) @oliver — produce airgap effort breakdown + minimal installer prototype plan by next Wed. 3) @sarah — confirm FinSecure PoC start date and get AcmeHealth window. 4) @andrew — draft model bundle migration plan and offline loader checklist.

deploy-bot: created ticket INF-4823 "control-plane-vpc-runbook" assigned to kiran

sarah: noted re: timelines — I'll push FinSecure to earliest onboarding slot and share PoC requirements.

maya: will synthesize into a short decision doc and send for async sign-off. please add objections in thread. :thumbsup:

kiran: LGTM

andrew: +1

oliver: +1

sarah: +1

maya: thanks everyone — closing thread unless objections by EOD tomorrow.
